mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right window type for an enlarged opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right window type depends on your aesthetic preferences, functional needs, and the specific design of your home. Options include picture windows for expansive views, casement or awning windows for ventilation, or sliding doors for access. We recommend considering energy efficiency ratings and material durability, especially for homes in diverse climates like those found across the greater Bay Area, to ensure long-term performance and comfort.
